limitations: Critical public controls only; not whole-app correctness or performance qualification.
No physical-device, offline-install, durable-save, replay or raster acceptance.
Response errors and cancellations are retained; no app-cause inference from a failed smoke.
Selecting the current Journey card deliberately replaces only this fresh smoke attempt; replacement/departure confirmation is refused.
Chromium and WebKit desktop engines only; no Safari or physical-device equivalence claim.

The optional Missions mode enables existing performance diagnostics only on the initial Solo document. Received stage spans are elapsed time, not CPU attribution; an unreceived final boundary remains unknown.
